gloss: to add (in speech); to say in addition

definitions.gloss: to add something to what one has just said
definitions.explanation: To tack a further remark onto a statement already made, usually a short clarification or afterthought rather than a new topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{言|い}い{足|た}した。
⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{注意点|ちゅういてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{足|た}した。
examples.english: After the explanation, she added a caution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、「⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{足|た}した。
examples.english: As he started to get up from his seat, he added, "Please come a bit early tomorrow."

notes:
Compound of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧ (to add). Transitive: what is added takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and a quoted remark is marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{言|い}い{足|た}す: to add a word
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{足|た}す: to add at the end
- 「〜」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{足|た}す: to add, "…"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える→付け加える：11520_tsukekuwaeru⟧: to add, to append — the standard, slightly more formal choice, and usable of writing as well as speech
- ⟦{言|い}い{添|そ}える→言い添える：30558_iisoeru⟧: to add a remark — literary, often a softening or supportive comment
